description: This file defines the interface for a URI dispatcher using a trie data structure, supporting registration and lookup of URI handlers with wildcard variables, primarily for REST API routing.

classes.name: uriDispatcher
classes.description: Abstract object representing the URI dispatcher, managing URI handler registration and lookup.

classes.name: uriHandlerContainer
classes.description: Container holding a callback handler and its description for a specific URI template.

methods.name: uriDispatcherCreate
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new URI dispatcher instance.

methods.name: uriDispatcherDestroy
methods.description: Destroys and frees resources associated with a URI dispatcher.

methods.name: registerUriHandler
methods.description: Registers a new URI handler for a specified URI template with the dispatcher.

methods.name: locateUriHandler
methods.description: Finds and returns the handler and description for a given URI, populating variables into a hash map.

methods.name: uriHandlerContainerDestroy
methods.description: Frees resources associated with a uriHandlerContainer.

methods.name: uriDispatcherRegisterDirective
methods.description: Registers a directive handler for manipulating URI variables.
